newsitem.title: USA: China may have bought 50,000 T US soybeans - trade.
newsitem.headline: China may have bought 50,000 T US soybeans - trade.

text.p: Indications are that China has bought 50,000 tonnes U.S. soybeans for November shipment in the past few days, several U.S. exporters said.
But exporters could not confirm rumors that China purchased 125,000 tonnes U.S. soymeal for July/August shipment.
"I'm not sure about the meal but about the beans, it did happen," one U.S. exporter said. "I think they did it a couple days ago." He did not have any other details.
"It's very possible," a second U.S. exporter said, referring to the Chinese soybean purchase.
Regarding a soymeal purchase, "if anything it would be from South America and not from the (United) States because of availability," he said.
A third exporter said his firm did not do the business but he believed the China soybean purchase was done.
He said he was not aware of a soymeal purchase.
